claims.text: Every Windows backend launch path (shell.cmd run, tray _start_backend, scripts/run-backend-svc.cmd) uses the production entry glossa_lab.main:create_app --factory on 127.0.0.1:8001, with no --reload, no 0.0.0.0 bind, and no main:app object.
falsification_tests: Any of the three files containing 'glossa_lab.main:app', '0.0.0.0', or '--reload' in a launch context.

evidence.description: Static contract tests in backend/tests/test_desktop_host_migration.py over the three files; desktop verify run shows the listening process command line.

claims.text: The installed Windows launch chain sets GLOSSA_MODE=installed (launch-tray.vbs, run-backend-svc.cmd, tray backend child env), so the backend data directory is %LOCALAPPDATA%\GlossaLab\data regardless of the caller's working directory.
falsification_tests: An installed-chain launcher without GLOSSA_MODE=installed, or a desktop backend that opens a repo-local ./data directory.

evidence.description: Static contract tests for the setting in all three places; backend config.py installed-mode mapping; desktop verify health payload served from the migrated database.

claims.text: setup-os.cmd stop terminates only Glossa Lab processes: shutdown endpoint, tray via stop-tray.vbs, backend via port-8001 PIDs whose command line matches this repo's uvicorn invocation. It never kills pythonw.exe or python.exe machine-wide.
falsification_tests: Any machine-wide image-name kill in the stop path, or a stop run that terminates an unrelated pythonw.exe process.

evidence.description: Static contract test asserting the absence of 'taskkill /F /IM pythonw.exe' and '/IM python.exe' and the presence of the stop-tray.vbs call and command-line filter.

claims.text: Exactly one Windows autostart mechanism exists after install: the GlossaLab scheduled task (wscript.exe + launch-tray.vbs) registered by setup-os.cmd install. services/windows/install.cmd delegates to it and creates no Startup shortcut.
falsification_tests: services/windows/install.cmd creating a .lnk targeting shell.cmd tray, or both a task and a GlossaLab Startup shortcut present after install.

evidence.description: Static contract tests over services/windows/*.cmd; desktop GLOSSA_TASK_STATE marker plus a Startup-folder listing in the migration record.

claims.text: setup-os.cmd install verifies the packaged tray icon assets by SHA-256 (ICO 315940742d75720388264dcdf03178c58f878ea0701d03eeba95688d935ff520, PNG bb41bf09d4177cee0c96b29ebe480f86a9e7115946f9e4ad132d2367a7adb077) and fails loudly, registering nothing, when either is missing or mismatched.
falsification_tests: An install that succeeds with a corrupted or absent icon asset, or pins absent from the installer.

evidence.description: Hash pins in setup-os.cmd asserted by static contract tests; GLOSSA_ICON_HASH marker from the desktop verify run.

claims.text: On Windows the tray supervises the backend: a dead backend is restarted by the tray's health poller, capped at 3 restarts per rolling hour, and a deliberate user stop is never auto-restarted.
falsification_tests: A kill test where the backend stays dead while the tray runs with restart budget remaining, or an auto-restart after the owner chose Stop Service.

evidence.description: Tray poller restart logic with _MAX_AUTO_RESTARTS=3 and a user-stop flag in tray/glossa_tray/main.py; GLOSSA_RESTART_TEST marker with old and new PIDs from the desktop verify run.

claims.text: Desktop verification proves identity and supervision, not liveness: scripts/verify-desktop-host.cmd emits GLOSSA_HOST_HEALTH, GLOSSA_HOST_IDENTITY, GLOSSA_TRAY_PROCESS, GLOSSA_ICON_HASH, GLOSSA_TASK_STATE and GLOSSA_RESTART_TEST, with identity requiring /docs 200, a healthy/degraded health payload with version, and OpenAPI title 'Glossa Lab' with matching version; every wait is bounded.
falsification_tests: A verify PASS against a non-Glossa process answering on port 8001, a missing marker, or an unbounded wait in the verify path.

evidence.description: scripts/verify_desktop_host.py reusing services/linux/healthcheck.py validate_identity; unit tests for its helpers; the marker block harvested from the desktop run in the migration record.

claims.text: The desktop backend is reachable remotely only over the owner's tailnet: it binds 127.0.0.1 on the desktop and Tailscale Serve fronts it; there is no public bind, funnel, or third-party tunnel.
falsification_tests: Any launch path binding 0.0.0.0, a serve configuration with a public funnel, or the backend answering on a public interface.

evidence.description: Launch-path binds (C080-1); tailscale serve status captured in the inventory/verify runs; MCP get_status answered from the VM via the tailnet route before cutover.

claims.text: The production database moved as a consistent, verified snapshot: source backend stopped, snapshot taken via the SQLite backup API, SHA-256 recorded on the VM, transferred only through the desktop-runner fleet mechanism, and SHA-256 plus PRAGMA integrity_check re-verified on the desktop before first start.
falsification_tests: A hash mismatch, a snapshot copied from a running backend, an integrity_check failure, or any transfer leg via git, a public file host, or a public artifact.

evidence.description: Migration record: snapshot hash on both sides, integrity_check result, transfer job ids from the gatekeeper ledger.
